memories.memory: I was diagnosed with high blood pressure in 2021, and I now take 10 mg of amlodipine every morning.
After years of long-distance cycling, an MRI in February 2024 showed moderate osteoarthritis in my right knee.
I completed six weeks of physiotherapy last autumn for a torn calf muscle that kept me from training for nearly two months.
My doctor suspects mild sleep apnea because I snore heavily and often wake up tired, so I am scheduled for a sleep study this month.
I take atorvastatin each night because my cholesterol was still above 240 mg/dL despite exercising regularly.
I had cataract surgery on my left eye in May 2023, and I am still using prescription drops for occasional dryness.
Before important exhibitions, I sometimes experience bouts of anxiety with a racing heartbeat, and my physician taught me breathing exercises instead of prescribing medication.
